parsed.reason: Correct language, all facts (Hale, Village Hale Technologies Inc., Barton Dong, villagehale.com, aloha@villagehale.com) spelled right, no invented facts or promises. Does not explain how the number was obtained, which the parent asked, though the purpose is identity so this is minor. Tone is plain and not defensive, slightly formal ("is accountable for it") but acceptable. Stop-texting line is helpful and not a promise beyond the facts... "I will" is a reasonable Hale commitment tied to the request. Deducted a point for the unanswered "how did you get my number" and somewhat stiff phrasing.
